name: @jeldon/ideation
description: Topic ideation: a transcript miner (published or private recordings, conditional timestamps), a read-only Reddit radar that turns engine-cited and archived threads into briefs, and a topic backlog defined by one Zod schema shared by reader and writer. Every prompt is built from the Domain Pack. Ported from Body of Health topics/episode.ts, topics/backlog.ts, topics/reddit.ts, command/reddit.ts and fetch-reddit-radar.mjs.
